ma mo'i phrin las dwa phrug gdung ba'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs/e bhyo/chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang*/ /kun tu bzang mo'i rol ba las/ /'jig rten ga

tei:div.tei:p: ma mo'i phrin las dwa phrug gdung ba'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs/ e bhyo/ chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang*// kun tu bzang mo'i rol ba las// 'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i// legs nyes stangs 'dzin ma mor sprul// 'byung lnga'i mnga' bdag ma mo ni// sngags bdag smug nag ral gcig ma// e ka dza ṭī khrag 'thung yum// 'jigs byed srid pa'i las mkhan mo// ma gcig dpal ldan dur khrod bdag /nam gru nag mo shan pa'i gtso// bye ba 'bum phrag ma mo'i 'khor// rnal 'byor skyong ba'i g.yal gam can// gsang sngags bka' yi bya ra ba// rdo rje 'chang gi tha tshig can// tshur byon sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon// dam tshig gnyan la dgongs te byon// bde gshegs bka' la dgongs te byon// rnal 'byor dbyangs la gsan te byon// gsang chen bstan la dgongs te byon// ma g.yel ma dang sring mo'i tshogs// dam tshig gnyan po'i gzhal yas 'dir// lhun grub 'od lnga'i spyan gzigs bkram// shes rab rang byung srog 'khor bris// sku dang thig les bla rdo bcas// rang snang rgyan rdzogs sku mkhar la// ye nas lhun grub brten par bzhugs// gdod nas zung 'jug yangs pa la// lha dang rnal 'byor gnyis su med// dbyings kyi rje mo nam mkha'i ngang*/ khyab bdal chen mo a la la// sngags bdag ral gcig shan pa yum// dpal gyi ma tshogs 'khor bcas la// dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa ni// gzung 'dzin rang grol ye shes rtsal// phyi nang nyer spyod mchod pa'i sprin// dbang lnga'i 'dod yon rol pa'i rgyan// gdod nas dag pa'i dam tshig rdzas// gsang mchod sman rag gtor mas bskang*// chos nyid mtha' bral lta bas bskang*// zung 'jug yangs pa'i sgom pas bskang*// shar grol 'dzin med spyod pas bskang*// re dogs yongs zad 'bras bu'i bskang*// gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni// sha sna snying sna khrag sna stong*// dza gad dkar dmar skyems dang bcas// mchod pa'i rdzas dang brten pa'i rdzas// bsgrub rdzas sku gsung thugs kyi rten// rang byung mchog gi longs spyod 'dis// tsa ti smug nag yum chen ma// nam gru nag mo sha za'i gtso// ma mo'i gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang*// srid pa'i rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// sngags kyi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*// rnal 'byor skyong ma'i thugs dam bskang*// ma dang sring mo'i thugs dam bskang*// 'jig rten dbang bsgyur ma mo'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// chos nyid rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang*// gdod nas dag pa'i chos sku la// rtog pa tha dad 'khrul ba yis// nyams pa gang mchis mthol bshags na// tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐/

don dam spros bral chos sku'i ngang*// rang bzhin gsal stong longs sku'i yum// thugs rjes sprul sku'i ma mor shar// sku gsum bdag nyid ma mor bstod// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'jig rten tshul// drag gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku// 'jigs byed ru lu'i nga ro sgrogs// mthu stobs sprul pa bsam mi khyab// sngags srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod// srung ma khyed brten rnal 'byor bdag /'di snang 'khrul pa rgyab tu bor// gzhan don byang chub don gnyer nas// nges med sna tshogs dben pa'i gnas// phyogs las rnam rgyal brtul zhugs kyis// snang ba dbang bsgyur rgyu ba'i dus// ma mo lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs// bdag ni dang po'i las can te// gal te dam las 'gal srid na// ma mo 'khor bcas phrag ma dog /gzhung bzhin du ni bshags bgyid lags// de phyir legs nyes bdag mo rnams// ma g.yel ma bzhin byams pas skyong*// ma mo sring ltar brtse bar mdzod// ma mo mdza' ltar gdung bar gyis// ma mo bran ltar 'du bar gyis// 'di bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// brtse dang gdung ba'i sems kyis ni// stongs grogs gnad nas khyod 'bog na// dge zhing zhi ba'i phrin las sgrubs// nyams rtogs ye shes rgyas par mdzod// snang srid dbang bsdud phrin las mdzod// byang chub sgrub pa'i dgra dang bgegs// gzugs can gzugs med thal bar rlog /mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam dgongs nas// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa ni nges med kyi rgyal khams nyul snyam pa'i dus su/ sngags bdag mo dang nam gru nag mo gnyis kyis dngos su gang bcol gyis phrin las sgrub par khas blangs pa'i dus su 'od gsal theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis gang shar du phrin las bcol ba'o// ༈ hūm̐/ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang gi phyogs// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri steng na// nor lha ser po 'dzum bag can// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// g.yas pas rin chen rgyal mtshan phyar// g.yas la bskor bas phywa g.yang sdud// g.yon la bskor bas tshe dpal 'gugs// g.yon pas ne'u le rkyal ba bsnams// dgos 'dod nor gyi char pa 'bebs// lcam dral bka' sdod brgyad la sogs// gnod sbyin bye ba bdun 'bum bcas// gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol// g.yal gam gtsang ma'i gnad la bzhugs// phyi nang nyer spyod sman rag gtor// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin gyis// rnam thos bu yi thugs dam bskang*// lcam dral 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod// nor lha 'khor bcas mchod pa'i mthus// dgos 'dod nor gyi g.yang khug cig

/snyan grags mthu yi g.yang khug cig /bsod nams gdul bya'i g.yang khug cig /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam tshig can// rnal 'byor srung skyob phrin las myur// gsang bdag dpa' bo'i bka' nyan sde// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ༈ shan pa nag mo'i phrin las srin mo'i ngur dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bhyoḥ rang mdun mun pa dgu 'khrigs klong*// me rlung dmar nag 'tshubs ma'i dbus// maḥlas gsod byed lha mo nag /'jigs rung srin po'i gad rgyangs can// srog sgrub nag mo mun pa'i mdog /ral pa lan tshar spu gris gtams/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa gtum pa'i sku// chibs su srid pa'i rlung nag zhon// srog gcod ma mo sde gzhi dang*// ma sring mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas// dam tshig can gyi drod nyul zhing*// dam nyams srog gcod las mkhan mo// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs gnas 'dir byon// dam la 'dus shing rten la bzhugs// hūm̐/ dgongs shig ma mo las mkhan ma// 'di na rnal 'byor dam re gtsang*// sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bkrag re che// lhun mnyam yangs pa gnas re bzang*// rang byung dkyil 'khor ma mo'i dal// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i longs spyod che// gnas 'dir srung ma dam la shog /gsod byed nag mo dam la shog /srog gcod sde bzhi dam la shog /nga ni padma'i gdung 'tshob yin/ khyod ni de yi srung ma che// de ring thugs dam bskang ba ni// zhun chen mar me mdangs dang ldan// tshil chen bdug spos dri zhim zhing*// dbang lnga'i me tog brjid re che// khrag mkhris dri chab dang re spro// sha rus zhal zas ro mchog ldan// rkang gling thod rnga gdangs re snyan// 'di ni srung ma mnyes pa'i rdzas// dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba'i phyir// 'bul lo drag mo drag shul can// gsol lo srid pa'i las mkhan mo// bzhengs shig srog gcod sde bzhi'i tshogs// bskang ngo ma sring rgya mtsho rnams// dam tshig can la dngos grub stsol// 'gal ba can la drag shul ston// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// srung skyob phrin las ma g.yel cig

/oṃ/ khyi kha le nag mos sod: srog la sri sod: snying kha kha baṃ: ya ya sod: tsa baṃ bi tu mu sod: gha ya sod: nriya sod: rakmo tsitta rbud: rakmo tsitta rbad: e dam bā lingta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ hūm̐/ mu stegs gsod byed lha mo ni// gdod nas mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i 'gro la ma mor ston// drag sngags mthu rtsal nus pa'i dpyid// sngags kyi bstan srung mthu mo che// las byed ma mo 'khor bcas la// rab tu dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang*// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'// padma las 'brel rtsal la sogs// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bca' dran mdzod la// 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa dang*// bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la// bsam sbyor log pa'i dgra 'dre rnams// tshe srog kha rje dbang thang bcas// ma mo 'khor bcas za skal gtad/ lo zlar ma bzhag myur du rol// bka' lung rjes 'brang phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di ni nam gru nag mos sngon gyi dam tshig gi rjes su 'brang nas shin tu 'go ba'i mtshan ma byung ba'i dus su 'od gsal theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa'o// hūm̐/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// srid pa'i ma mo g.yal gam can// shan pa nag mo char sprin mdog /ral pa g.yengs bas gnam sa khyab// phyag na spu gri snying rlon 'chang*// zhing lpags rlon pa'i na bza' gsol// ma sring mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs// tshur gshegs sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// srog 'khor bla rdo rten la bzhugs// dgra bgegs bsgral phyir phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang nyer spyod mchod pa'i sprin// sman dang rakta ba lingta// sbyor sgrol gnyis med byang chub sems// gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni// bsad khrag sna tshogs rba klong 'khrugs// keng rus phung po ri ltar spungs// maṃ sa sha dang tshil chen gsur// thod rnga rkang gling rol mo dang*// dza gad dpa' bo'i snying khrag rnams// ma dang sring mo'i tshogs la 'bul// dgyes bzhes mchog gi dngos grub stsol// byang chub sgrub pa'i dgra dang bgegs// glo bur gri rgod hur thum yang*// dus bzhi nam yang 'bral med du// srung zhing skyob par khyod brten na// drag rtsal nus mthu ma chung zhig

/bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// sgrub po bla ma dam pa o rgyan tshe bstan nas bskul ngor theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ hūm̐/ lha yi dge bsnyen drag po rtsal// sku la dar dkar ral ka gsol// btsan rgod bya ra stong gis bskor// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// srog 'khor bla rdo rten la bzhugs// dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi// sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spungs// mthun rdzas ra yi sha khrag gis// gter srung ldang lha mched 'khor bcas// thugs dam dgyes pa skong gyur gcig /ba ri ba ri ging ka ra dza dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐ḥ lha btsan ldang lha drag po rtsal// slob dpon padma'i dam tshig can// mkha' 'gro gsang ba snying thig gi /gter bdag bka' yi srung mar bstod/ khyod la dam bskul las brtson na/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bstan 'dzin rig 'dzin bdag cag la// gnod 'chang sbyor rtsub dgra bgegs dang*// byang chub sgrub la bar chod pa'i// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ khrag skyugs nad kyis sod la shog /mtshon gri sbos gri glang thab sod// da lta nyid du sod la shog /ming med thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog /da dung phrin las mi mdzad na// lha btsan khyed la ci byung gi /dam tshig gnyen po 'dor ram ci// dam la ma 'da' phrin las mdzod// ces pa ni mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bsnyen sgrub la gnas dus gter srung gtor ma la 'khongs ba'i nyams zhig shar nas sngags btsun las kyi rdo rjes mkha' 'gro snying thig gi ldang lha'i sgrub thabs la brten nas bris pa dge'o// hūm̐ bhyoḥ kun tu bzang po nyid bzhi mu kha le// mkha' dbyings rnam dag gsang rol bde klong nas// rig rtsal rdzogs sku smug nag 'od 'phro ma// thugs kyi mon mo srog sgrub 'bar ma nag /dus mtha'i mun pa'i mdog 'dra 'jigs pa'i gzugs// drag shul bhyo dang ru lu'i gad rgyang sgrogs// brtse ba'i thugs kyi dam tshig ming por dgongs// gtum pa'i yid kyis nyams pa'i srog la rngam// dam tshig dbang gis sgrub pa'i drod tshad nyul// ma mo srog la dgyes phyir 'dir gshegs la// bdud rtsi dam rdzas dmar chen 'di gsol zhig

/thugs dam rgyud bskul sngar gyi dam tshig dgongs// zab gsang snying thig bstan pa phun tshogs spel// rdo rje rgyal po'i sku tshe ring du bsring*// lta log nyams pa'i snying khrag hub kyis 'thung*// khyad par dam tshig sgrub pa'i gnas rnams su// kun bzang padma las 'brel rtsal 'chang ba'i// dri med 'od zer gter 'byin chos kyi bdag /gdod ma'i mgon po rtsa ba'i bla ma yis// chos rigs slob rgyud rnal 'byor rig 'dzin dang*// skad cig 'bral med lus dang grib ltar du// g.yel med srung skyob phrin las bsgrub po zhes// sus kyang ma bcol nyid kyi zhal bzhes pa'i// tha tshig ci bzhin dus 'dir myur dgongs la// rnam bzhi'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// 'di ni bla ma rin po che tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gsung lags/// /
